folds.title: Chatbot or agent?
points: An **AI agent** keeps going: it decides its own steps and uses tools.
It looks at the results and carries on until the job is done.

folds.title: Workflow or agent
points: Anthropic separates two kinds of system.
**Workflow**: code lays out the steps in advance.
**Agent**: the model directs its own process and its use of tools.

folds.title: Claude Code as an agent
points: **Check the result:** run the test again.
folds.note: You can interrupt at any point to steer.

folds.title: When agents fit
points: Open-ended jobs where you cannot predict the steps.
They cost more in time and money.
Mistakes can pile up, so test them with guardrails.

folds.title: Start simple
points: Anthropic's advice: use the plainest solution that works.
Add an agent only when simpler options fall short.

folds.prompt: Workflow or agent? Tap the basket.
